name: John Lloyd Higgins
description: John Lloyd Higgins is a family-run pumpkin patch in Roanoke, AL. It grows Pumpkins, Squash, Corn, Tomatoes, and Peppers, with picking through autumn, summer, and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Sep – Nov in this growing zone.
